contexts.text: By the Kingdom of God, in the universal sense, is meant the universal Heaven; in a sense less universal, the true Church of the Lord; in a particular one, everyone who is of true faith, or has been regenerated through the life of faith; and therefore he is called Heaven... and also the Kingdom of God, because the Kingdom of God is in him, as the Lord teaches in... The Kingdom of God cometh not with observation... for behold the Kingdom of God is within you ().
The internal sense of the Word solely regards the Lord and His Kingdom.
The garden in Eden... = the Lord's Kingdom, and Heaven, in which man is placed when he has become celestial.
By the Holy City... nothing else is meant than the Lord's Kingdom in the universal, or in each one in particular in whom is the Lord's Kingdom.
Then the man of the Church has in him the Kingdom of the Lord; for the Kingdom of the Lord consists solely in mutual love and the derivative happiness.
The Land of Canaan = the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth.
Each and all things... were representative of the Lord's Kingdom. The Lord's Kingdom is such that everyone... must perform a use; nothing except use is regarded by the Lord in His Kingdom...
Such are slaves in the Lord's Kingdom, that is in the other life, for they are among the unhappy.
The internal sense never treats of other things than those which are of the Lord's Kingdom, thus which are of the Church. AC 1247.
Men dwelt distinct in nations, families, and houses... in order that the Church on earth might represent the Lord's Kingdom...
They have a situation in the Lord's Kingdom according to...
The Holy Jerusalem = the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth.
Have as an end the common good of the Church, and of the Lord's Kingdom...
Such is the state and order in the Lord's Kingdom.
Represent the things of the Lord, of His Kingdom, and of the Church.
All things in the world present some idea of the Lord's Kingdom...
I will make thee into a great nation = the Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth...
Therefore the Lord is His Kingdom itself; that is, the all in all of His Kingdom.
A kingdom of priests = the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth as predicated from the celestial things of love...
All who live in ignorance and in charity are a nation, because they are of the Lord's Kingdom.
(The marriage of the Lord) with His Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth.
The celestial things of love alone are in the Lord's Kingdom, and constitute the Lord's Kingdom.
Represents the entrance of the faithful into the Lord's Kingdom.
In order to represent the celestial and spiritual things of the Kingdom and Church of the Lord.
The New Jerusalem, or the Lord's Kingdom.
For the sake of the Lord's Church on earth, and for the sake of the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens...
There is nothing in the Word which does not regard the Lord, His Kingdom, and the Church.
Treats of the new Church... in special, and of the Lord's Kingdom in the universal.
Canaan represented the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens, or Heaven; and the Lord's Kingdom on earth, or the Church.
Hence the Lord's Kingdom, or Heaven, is inmense.
For the New Jerusalem is nothing else than the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth. AC 2336.
The Lord's Kingdom is one of ends and uses.
Divine truth is the order itself of His universal Kingdom; all the laws of which are truths...
The new heavens and the new earth = ... the Lord's Kingdom, and everyone who is a Kingdom of the Lord, or in whom is the Lord's Kingdom.
That there would be only an external in the Lord's Kingdom. Signified, Explained.
Thus from all the diverse Churches there would be one... and the Lord's Kingdom would be effected on earth.
That the External shall not be heir of His Kingdom. Signified, Explained.
The Lord's Kingdom is mutual love. References.
A representation of the Lord's Kingdom in a view of the universe. Signified. AC 1810.
They would thus pass from the Lord's Kingdom on earth to the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens... as into the same...
If he has as an end the good of... the Lord's Kingdom...
(The internal sense) treats of the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens, and also of His Kingdom on earth, that is, of the Church; and in like manner of each one in whom is the Lord's Kingdom... AC 2165:3.
(Then) the Lord's Kingdom comes.
There is signified in a universal sense the Lord's Kingdom; in a sense less universal, the Church...
The interior things of charity are those in which consists the Lord's Kingdom. References.
The Church, in the Lord's Kingdom, is circumstanced as are the heart and lungs in man...
So do (these principles) succeed each other in the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens; and in the Church, which is the Lord's Kingdom on earth; and also in each one who is a Kingdom of the Lord.
There is such a conjunction (of good and truth) in the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens; and in the Lord's Kingdom on earth, or in the Church...
The Word conjoins Heaven with earth; that is, the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens with the Lord's Kingdom on earth. AC 2899.
Morning, in the Word, = the Lord's Kingdom, and whatever is of the Lord's Kingdom...
No one can be admitted into the Lord's Kingdom, that is, into Heaven, unless he is in the good of love and of charity...
Then there was the Lord's Kingdom on earth as in the Heavens.
The rise of a new Church... is the Lord's Kingdom on earth; and this both in general and particular... Explained.
The Lord's Kingdom on earth, which is the Church, they acknowledge still more as their neighbour...
The heavenly marriage is the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth; and therefore the Lord's Kingdom is so frequently called a marriage in the Word. Explained. AC 2649.
The Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth is celestial and spiritual...
They who live in conjugial love... have the Lord's Kingdom in them...
From Whom descends the heavenly marriage, which is the Lord's Kingdom itself in the Heavens.

The Lord's Kingdom on earth consists of all those who are in good, who, although scattered through the whole world, are still one, and as members constitute one body. Such is the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens...

All things in the Word... regard the Lord's Kingdom; for the Lord is everything in His Kingdom. The Divine things which are from the Lord in His Kingdom, make His Kingdom. Therefore, in proportion to the amount of good and truth which an Angel, Spirit, or man, receives from the Lord, and believes to be from the Lord, is he in His Kingdom. But in proportion as he does not receive it, nor believe that it is from the Lord, he is not in His Kingdom. Thus the Divine things which are from the Lord make His Kingdom, or Heaven; and this is what is meant by the Lord's being everything in His Kingdom.
In the beginning of a Church... everyone is affected... for the sake of the Lord's Kingdom...
For the Lord's Kingdom on earth is the Church.
The New Jerusalem, that is, the spiritual Kingdom of the Lord.
Which (new Church) is one in the Lord's Kingdom. Signified, Explained.
Hence it is that each and all things in the universe represent the Lord's Kingdom... AC 3483.
Virgin, in the Word, = the Lord's Kingdom, and also the Church; and thence everyone who is a Kingdom of the Lord, or who is a Church. Explained, Illustrated.
For the Divine of the Lord makes His Kingdom.

Land... = the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth, thus the Church, which is the Lord's Kingdom on earth. In like manner ground, but in a more restricted sense; and the same is signified also by field, but in a still more restricted sense.
In this light are those alone who are in the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens, that is, in Heaven; and who are in the Lord's Kingdom on earth, that is, in the Churches.
Not to be in a state of the good of love, thus not in the Lord's Kingdom. Signified.
The Divine is in the internal sense, because there is the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens... The Divine is also in the literal sense... because there is the Lord's Kingdom on earth...
The conjunction of the Lord's Kingdom on earth with the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens... by the Word. Treated of.
For in these things is the Lord's Kingdom itself.
(Thus) the visible universe is nothing else than a theatre representative of the Lord's Kingdom; and this is a theatre representative of the Lord Himself. AC 3648:end.
The universal Kingdom of the Lord is a Kingdom of ends and uses...

When the good of the neighbour, the common good, the good of the Church, and of the Lord's Kingdom, is the end, then as to his soul the man is in the Lord's Kingdom, thus with the Lord; for the Lord's Kingdom is nothing but a Kingdom of ends and uses for the sake of the good of the human race.

For truth and good, or faith and love, make the Lord's Kingdom... and as the Jewish Church was instituted to represent the Lord's Kingdom, the partitions of that people into twelve tribes signified these things.
To see the Kingdom of God () = to believe.
For the Lord is Divine love itself, and the influx of this makes His Kingdom, and this by the Word which is from Him.
To put on ends for the neighbour and for the Lord's Kingdom...

The Lord's Kingdom with man begins from the life which is of works; for he is then at the beginning of regeneration. But when the Lord's Kingdom is with man, it is terminated in works, and he is then regenerate.
Before man can enter into the Lord's Kingdom, that is, by regeneration become a Church.
The heavenly marriage is what is called the Lord's Kingdom, and also Heaven; and this because it comes forth from the Divine marriage, which is the Lord.
As innocence is the primary thing in the Lord's Kingdom...
As... the Lord's Kingdom is the marriage of good and truth...
Hence it is evident how the heavenly marriage, that is, the Lord's Kingdom, is in each thing of the Word.
(The lot of those who have no love towards the Lord's Kingdom.)
The land of Seir, in the relative sense, properly = the Lord's Kingdom with those who are outside the Church; that is, with the gentiles, when the Church is being established with them...
When a man is becoming a Church, or a Kingdom of the Lord...
The new earth, or Holy Land = the Lord's Kingdom, and also the New Church, which is the Lord's Kingdom on earth. References.
(For) all who are in good are in the Lord's Kingdom.
Its internal sense, in which it treats of the Lord's Kingdom, is for the Second Heaven.
Hence it is that the Lord's Kingdom is within man. Explained.
Israel... = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom in Heaven and earth... Jacob... = the Lord's Kingdom such as it is in the First Heaven...
When man is in interior truths in faith and life, he is in the Lord's Kingdom.
Hence the Lord likened the Kingdom of the Heavens, that is, His Kingdom in Heaven, and His Kingdom on earth, which is the Church, to a man a king, who made a wedding for his son...
For good is the essential itself of the Lord's Kingdom and Church.
The Kingdom of the Heavens shall be likened to ten virgins () = the last time of the Old Church and the first of the New; the Church is the Lord's Kingdom on earth.
The calling of all to the Lord's Kingdom. Treated of.
The heavenly marriage is Heaven itself, or the Lord's Kingdom; and the Lord's Kingdom on earth is the Church.
The new earth = the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth.
As there is what is representative of the Lord's Kingdom in each thing of nature... AC 5116:2.

The Kingdom of God which is compared to grass, an ear, and corn () is Heaven with man by regeneration; for he who is regenerate has in him the Kingdom of God, and becomes the Kingdom of God, or Heaven, in an image...
To receive the Kingdom of God as a child () = charity and faith from innocence.
When he is in the affection of truth for the sake of truth, that is, for the sake of the Lord's Kingdom... he is among the Angels.
When man is in this good and truth, the Lord's Kingdom is in him, consequently he is a Church...
The Kingdom of the Heavens = good and truth with man, thus Heaven with Him.
The Lord's Kingdom is still more the neighbour (than the Church). AC 6819:end.
The Lord's Kingdom for those who are in this good and truth. Signified.
For the good and truth themselves which are in the Lord's Kingdom, proceed from His Divine and Divine Human, and cause the Lord Himself... to be His Kingdom.
They are among those in the Lord's Kingdom who are in the lowest place.
That in this happiness are they who are in the Lord's Kingdom. Signified.
They who are such (as are meant by Dan) are in the Lord's Kingdom... but are among those in the Lord's Kingdom who are in the First Heaven.
In this prophetic utterance of Israel, by his twelve sons there are described in general as to their quality all who are in the Lord's Kingdom.
Thus the ultimates of the Land of Canaan represented the ultimates in the Lord's Kingdom.
But if truth is completely separated from good, it is then not in any boundary of the Lord's Kingdom, but is outside of it.
They who are such (as are signified by Gad) are also in the Lord's Kingdom, but at the threshold.
Their possession in the Lord's Kingdom while they are still in what is obscure. Signified.
Hence the Lord's Kingdom is called a Kingdom of ends and uses.
For by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob... in the representative sense, is meant the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens, and His Kingdom on earth, which is the Church.

He who loves his country, and from goodwill does good to it, in the other life loves the Lord's Kingdom; for there the Lord's Kingdom is his country: and he who loves the Lord's Kingdom, loves the Lord, because the Lord is the all in all of His Kingdom; for that which is properly called the Lord's Kingdom is good and truth which are with those who are there, from the Lord.

The Lord's Kingdom is the neighbour in a higher degree than the Church where anyone is born; for the Lord's Kingdom consists of all who are in good, both on earth and in the Heavens. Thus the Lord's Kingdom is Good with all its quality in the complex. When this good is loved, the individuals are loved who are in the good. Thus the whole, which is all good in the complex, is the neighbour in the first degree, and is that Grand Man... This Man, that is, the Lord's Kingdom, is loved, when from inmost affection good is done to those who are man through that Man from the Lord, thus those with whom is the Lord's Kingdom.
That the sons of Israel were to be distinguished... into classes according to the qualities of good... in order that they might represent the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens...
Hence it is that all Divine miracles represent the states of the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens, and of the Lord's Kingdom on earth, or the Church.
This communion, or this Church, is the Lord's Kingdom on earth conjoined with the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens...
For by the Land of Canaan is signified the Lord's Kingdom, thus Heaven and the Church.
The internal sense treats of the Lord's Kingdom. AC 8694:2. AC 8943.
He who knows the formation of good from truths... knows the arcana of the formation of man anew, that is, of the formation of Heaven or of the Lord's Kingdom with him...
Honour thy... mother = love for... the Lord's Kingdom.
Mother, in the supreme sense, = the Lord as to Divine truth, thus His Kingdom; for the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord makes Heaven. Explained.
Mother = the Lord's Kingdom, or Heaven... (for) the Lord's Kingdom is the same as the Church, with the sole difference, that the Lord's Kingdom on earth is called the Church...
Moreover, the Lord's Kingdom is the country of all who are therein; and our country is mother in the natural sense...
He is then a Heaven or Kingdom of the Lord, in particular.
That the Word in the internal sense... is in a degree above the Word in the external sense... is signified by, the lesser in the Kingdom of the Heavens is greater than he ().
The Kingdom of God () = Heaven with man, thus the good of love and the truth of faith.

Whether you say the Church with a man, or Heaven with him, or the Kingdom of God with him, or the Lord with him, it is the same; for the Church is the Lord's Heaven on earth; and the Kingdom of God is Heaven and the Church together...

They who in the world love the good of their country more than their own, and the good of their neighbour as their own, are they who in the other life love and seek the Lord's Kingdom; for there the Lord's Kingdom is in place of our country. TCR 414:end.
The Lord's Kingdom is a Kingdom of ends which are uses; or, what is the same, it is a Kingdom of uses which are ends... HH 387:end.
The same is meant by... the Kingdom of God is within you. The Kingdom of God = the Divine good and truth in which are the Angels.
That Heaven and the Church are called the Kingdom of the Lord. Illustrated.
The Kingdom of God = Heaven and the Church.
That the Kingdom of the Heavens = the Church...
The Kingdom of God is within you. By the Kingdom of God is here meant the Lord, and the Church which is from Him.
For the Lord's Kingdom, which is not only over Heaven, but also over Hell, is a Kingdom of uses.
That they will be in the Lord's Kingdom... Signified.
The Church everywhere is the Lord's Kingdom.
That then the Lord's Kingdom will come. Signified, Illustrated.
That it is the Lord's Kingdom which will be evangelized in the days of the voice of the seventh Angel. Illustrated.
That to evangelize = the Advent of the Lord, and His Kingdom then. Illustrated.

The Kingdom of our God, and the Power of His Christ () = because the Lord alone reigns in Heaven and in the Church... This is meant by the Gospel of the Kingdom, and by the Kingdom of God. Illustrated.
Hence Heaven and the Church are called the Lord's Kingdom. Illustrated.
That he who knows anything of the Advent of the Lord, and of the New Heaven and the New Church, and thus of the Lord's Kingdom, should pray that it may come. Signified.
Like things are also signified by... Thy Kingdom come. The Lord's Kingdom is the Church which makes one with Heaven...
That they will not have their lot with those who are in the Lord's Kingdom. Signified. For all things written in this Book regard the New Heaven and the New Church, which make the Lord's Kingdom...
The Kingdom of Christ, which is Heaven, is a Kingdom of uses.
The Kingdom of the Heavens = Heaven and the Church.
That the Church is the neighbour which is to be loved in a higher degree, and the Lord's Kingdom in the highest. General article.

Because by the Lord's Kingdom is meant the Church in the whole world which is called the Communion of Saints, and there is also meant Heaven; and therefore He who loves the Lord's Kingdom, loves all in the universal world who acknowledge the Lord, and have faith in Him, and charity towards the neighbour... They who love the Lord's Kingdom love the Lord above all things; consequently, above others they are in love to God; for the Church in the Heavens and on earth is the Lord's Body...

Therefore, love towards the Lord's Kingdom is love towards the neighbour in its fulness; for they who love the Lord's Kingdom not only love the Lord above all things, but also love the neighbour as themselves...
Therefore the Lord says, Seek ye first the Kingdom of the Heavens and its justice, then all things shall be added to you (). That the Kingdom of the Heavens is the Lord's Kingdom. Illustrated.
That unless a man is generated anew... he cannot enter into the Kingdom of God. General article.
By the Kingdom of God is meant Heaven and the Church; for the Kingdom of God on earth is the Church. Illustrated.
A description of the Kingdom of God.
The Lord's Kingdom is now turned from those called Christians to others.
It is important then to know the nature of the government in the Lord's Kingdom...
On the Lord's Kingdom.
They can serve as ultimates in the Lord's Kingdom.
The Kingdom of God = the Church as to truths, thus also the truths of the Church.
Kingdom = the Church, and therefore it is called the Kingdom of God.
The Kingdom of the Heavens, to which the ten virgins are likened, = Heaven and the Church. ( = the Church. AE 548:3.)
His Kingdom () = Heaven and the Church.
The Kingdom of God is nigh () = the Lord's New Church.
The Kingdom of the Heavens () = the Spiritual World and the Church.
Those in the Lord's Kingdom. Signified.
The Lord's Kingdom is Heaven and the Church, where the Lord is worshipped, and where the Divine in His Human is acknowledged...
The Kingdom of God, in these passages, = a New Heaven and a New Church from the Lord.

That the Lord's Kingdom is the reception of Divine good and Divine truth... These are the things by which the Lord reigns; consequently they are properly the Lord's Kingdom with those who receive them...
The Lord... rules also those who do not receive, as all in Hell; but still it cannot be said that the Lord's Kingdom is there...
That that is the Lord's Kingdom which proceeds from Him and is received, is evident from the places in the Word where the Kingdom of God is mentioned. Illustrated.

Seek ye first the Kingdom of the Heavens... By the Kingdom of the Heavens, in the spiritual sense, is meant the Divine truth... and, in the supreme sense, by the Kingdom of the Heavens is meant the Lord, because He is the all of His Kingdom.

As Heaven is Heaven from the reception of Divine truth from the Lord, in like manner the Church, therefore, in the common sense, Heaven and the Church are meant by the Kingdom of God, and the Kingdom of the Heavens...

That the Kingdom of God = the Church as to truths from good, and also Heaven; and that the Kingdom of God with man = to be in truths from good from the Lord, thus in wisdom, and thence in the power to resist evils and falsities. Reference.
The Kingdom of the Heavens () = the Lord's Church in the Heavens and on earth; for the Church is everywhere. AE 1044:3.
Therefore the Third Heaven is called the Lord's Dominion, and the Second Heaven, the Lord's Kingdom...
The Kingdom of the Heavens () = the Lord and His Church.

This is meant by Thy Kingdom come on earth as in the Heavens. The Lord's Kingdom was also before the Last Judgment, for the Lord always rules Heaven and earth, but the state of the Lord's Kingdom became different after the Last Judgment...
The Lord is the Kingdom of God; thus is Heaven and the Church.
